description:
Modern two-bedroom apartment designed for professionals in the heart of Leeds. At Mercer West & Madison East, enjoy spacious layouts, premium resident amenities and a professionally managed community, all within easy reach of the city centre.

Whether you're relocating, commuting or simply looking for a place to call home, Mercer West & Madison East offers modern open-plan living with a contemporary fitted kitchen, integrated appliances, stylish bathroom, high-quality finishes and superfast Wi-Fi included in your rent. 

Residents also enjoy exclusive access to a fully equipped gym, co-working spaces,  residents' lounge, courtyard, secure parcel collection, cycle storage and a year-round programme of resident events. 

Perfectly positioned close to Leeds Train Station, major employers, hospitals, universities, restaurants and shopping, with a coffee shop just moments from your doorstep, everything you need for modern city living is within easy reach. 

Please note: Images shown are for illustrative purposes and may not reflect the exact apartment available. Furnishings and layouts may vary.

Additional costs apply.
